arr.description: A Tensor, RaggedTensor, or SparseTensor whose values should be counted. These tensors must have a rank of 2 if `axis=-1`.

weights.description: If non-None, must be the same shape as arr. For each value in `arr`, the bin will be incremented by the corresponding weight instead of 1. If non-None, `binary_output` must be False.

minlength.description: If given, ensures the output has length at least `minlength`, padding with zeros at the end if necessary.

maxlength.description: If given, skips values in `arr` that are equal or greater than `maxlength`, ensuring that the output has length at most `maxlength`. dtype: If `weights` is None, determines the type of the output bins.

name.description: A name scope for the associated operations (optional).

axis.description: The axis to slice over. Axes at and below `axis` will be flattened before bin counting. Currently, only `0`, and `-1` are supported. If None, all axes will be flattened (identical to passing `0`).

binary_output.description: If True, this op will output 1 instead of the number of times a token appears (equivalent to one_hot + reduce_any instead of one_hot + reduce_add). Defaults to False.

output.description: A vector with the same dtype as `weights` or the given `dtype` containing the bincount values.
